# 2019 Tour de Wallonie

The 2019 Tour de Wallonie was the 40th edition of this Belgian professional cycling stage race.

## Key Details

- **Date:** July 27–31, 2019
- **Location:** Wallonia region of Belgium
- **Classification:** UCI 2.HC (part of the UCI Europe Tour)
- **Stages:** 5 stages

## Overall Winner

**Jasper Philipsen** (Belgium) of UAE Team Emirates won the overall general classification. This was a notable victory for the young Belgian sprinter early in his professional career.

## Race Format

The Tour de Wallonie typically features a mix of stages suited for sprinters and punchy riders, traversing the hilly terrain of the Walloon region. It often serves as preparation for riders ahead of late-summer classics and other major races.

## Significance

The race attracts a mix of ProTeam and Professional Continental teams and has historically been a platform for emerging Belgian talent as well as established riders looking to gain race fitness.
